name: beaufort12
description: Mailchimp and Dropbox operations on your Salesforce records, from Claude.

salesforce_mcp_url.title: Salesforce MCP server URL
salesforce_mcp_url.description: From Setup → MCP Servers in your Salesforce org. Production: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/custom/<ApiName>. Sandbox: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/sandbox/custom/<ApiName>. Add only the Beaufort 12 actions you have installed. The server must be Active.

salesforce_oauth_client_id.title: Salesforce External Client App Consumer Key
salesforce_oauth_client_id.description: OAuth Client ID from the Hosted MCP External Client App (mcp_api + JWT named-user tokens). Not the B12 Mailchimp or Dropbox gateway app. Required so Claude Code does not attempt Dynamic Client Registration.
